basic_profile.bio: I'm a college student currently exploring different fields of technology and programming. Originally from Seattle, I spend most of my time juggling between my studies and exploring new tech gadgets. Being relatively new to Reddit, I enjoy diving into discussions that range from tech innovations to lifestyle tips. I'm usually online during late evenings after my classes. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time learning new coding languages and exploring different aspects of digital culture.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a tech enthusiast and a newcomer to programming, I've been learning through online courses and forums. My studies at college have introduced me to basic programming concepts, and I frequently visit tech-related subreddits to expand my knowledge.
